panels.title: Qdrant
panels.description: Proxy: healthy if gateway can read locus_items collection.

panels.title: Gemini Judge
panels.description: Proxy: healthy if judge cache has entries (judge has been called at least once).

panels.title: Visual Engine
panels.description: UP immediately on start. Models load in background � /health returns {status:loading} until ready (~60s)

panels.title: Prometheus
panels.description: Always green when this dashboard is visible.

panels.title: Grafana
panels.description: Always green when this dashboard is visible.

panels.title: Searches — Last Minute
panels.description: Total search requests in the last 60 seconds.

panels.title: Errors — Last Minute
panels.description: 4xx + 5xx HTTP errors in the last 60 seconds.

panels.title: Search Latency P95
panels.description: 95th-percentile response time for /search over the last 2 minutes.

panels.title: AI Judge Latency P95
panels.description: 95th-percentile latency of the Gemini attribute tagger (AI evaluation component).

panels.title: Feedback: Positive vs Negative
panels.description: Positive (4-5★) vs negative (1-2★) feedback counts side by side.

panels.title: Last Retraining
panels.description: Judge score delta (new − old) of the last completed retraining run. Green = model was promoted. Red = rejected.

panels.title: Avg VSS@5
panels.description: Average Gemini Visual Similarity Score across all golden queries. Target: >0.70.

panels.title: Queries Evaluated
panels.description: Number of golden queries scored in the latest eval run.

panels.title: Eval Coverage
panels.description: How many distinct golden queries exist in the dataset.

panels.title: VSS@5 Per Golden Query
panels.description: Individual Gemini score per golden query. Red below 0.50 = alert: that query needs attention.

panels.title: Search Quality per Category
panels.description: Average VSS@5 broken down by detected clothing category. Reveals which categories the model struggles with.

panels.title: VSS@5 Trend — Across Eval Runs
panels.description: Should improve after each successful LoRA promotion.

panels.title: Judge Score Old → New
panels.description: Gemini judge avg score: old deployed model vs new candidate from last retrain.

panels.title: CLIP Confidence — P50 & P90 (per /vectorize call)
panels.description: Tracks how confident CLIP is in its top category label. Sustained P50 < 0.4 or a sudden drop indicates model drift or distribution shift.

panels.title: CLIP Confidence — Current Median
panels.description: P50 CLIP category confidence over the last 5 minutes. Below 0.35 = consider retraining.

panels.title: LoRA Run Outcomes
panels.description: How many total runs were promoted vs not promoted.

panels.title: New Model hit@5
panels.description: hit@5 of the most recently trained candidate model on the golden dataset.

panels.title: New Model ACS@5
panels.description: Average Cosine Similarity of top-5 results from the new candidate model. Measures geometric closeness in embedding space.

panels.title: Baseline hit@5
panels.description: hit@5 of the currently deployed model. New models must beat this − 0.02 to be promoted.

panels.title: Latest Δjudge
panels.description: Judge score improvement of the last retrain vs baseline. Positive = new model is better.

panels.title: Promotion Decision
panels.description: Was the last retrained model promoted to production? Green = yes, red = no.

panels.title: Last Retrain Duration
panels.description: How long the last LoRA training job took from start to finish.

panels.title: Total Promotions
panels.description: How many times a retrained model has been deployed to production across all time.

panels.title: Recall@K Trend — Across Eval Runs
panels.description: Recall at top-5, 10, 25 improving over time as models are retrained.

panels.title: Eval Quality Trend
panels.description: New model hit@5 and ACS@5 from each completed retrain run over time.

panels.title: Latest Train Loss
panels.description: InfoNCE loss at current step. Should decrease during training.

panels.title: Failed Runs
panels.description: Runs that ended with an error (OOM, timeout, data error). Requires locus_lora_failed_runs_total from mlops_exporter.

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of retrain runs that completed without error.

panels.title: Last Failure Reason
panels.description: Error code of the last failed run. Requires locus_lora_last_error_code from mlops_exporter. 0=none, 1=OOM, 2=timeout, 3=data error.

panels.title: Avg Run Duration
panels.description: Average wall-clock time of all completed retrain runs. Requires locus_lora_avg_run_duration_seconds from mlops_exporter.

panels.title: Data Points Used
panels.description: Feedback + golden samples used in the last training run. Requires locus_lora_data_points_used from mlops_exporter.

panels.title: Train Loss Curve (live)
panels.description: InfoNCE loss over training steps. Updates every 30s. Should decrease as training progresses.

panels.title: Total Ratings
panels.description: All ratings stored in locus_feedback (users + AI judge combined).

panels.title: Actual User Ratings
panels.description: Ratings submitted by real shoppers (source = user).

panels.title: AI Judge Ratings
panels.description: Ratings generated by the automated AI quality judge (all auto_judge* sources).

panels.title: Average Star Rating
panels.description: Mean star score across all feedback records in Qdrant.

panels.title: Positive / Negative
panels.description: Count of positive (4-5★) vs negative (1-2★) training signals.

panels.title: Ready to Train
panels.description: Green when positive + negative ratings ≥ 50 (LoRA training threshold).

panels.title: Star Distribution — All
panels.description: Rating count per star level (users + AI judge combined).

panels.title: Star Distribution — Users Only
panels.description: Rating count per star from actual shoppers only.

panels.title: Star Distribution — AI Judge Only
panels.description: Rating count per star from automated AI quality judge.

panels.title: Training Signal Breakdown
panels.description: Ratings grouped into positive (4-5★), neutral (3★), negative (1-2★) training signals.

panels.title: Feedback Trend Over Time
panels.description: Running total of positive / neutral / negative signals in Qdrant (refreshed every 60s).

panels.title: Time on Results Page
panels.description: How long users spend looking at search results before navigating away. Histogram bucketed.

panels.title: Click-Through Rate by Position
panels.description: How many times each result position (1=top-left, 2, 3...) was clicked. Lower positions should dominate if search quality is good.

panels.title: Skipped Products
panels.description: Products rejected during ingestion (no clothing detected, low confidence, or corrupt).

panels.title: Feedback Records
panels.description: User star ratings collected. Need 200+ for LoRA fine-tuning.

panels.title: Corrupt Items Flagged
panels.description: Products with corrupt_flag_count ≥ 1. A second flag triggers auto-deletion.

panels.title: Stores Indexed
panels.description: Distinct store names with at least one product in locus_items (counted directly from Qdrant every 60s).

panels.title: Stores with Missing Info
panels.description: Stores where products are missing store name, image URL, or coordinates. Requires backend endpoint — noted for later.

panels.title: Collection Sizes Over Time
panels.description: Track catalog growth and feedback accumulation.

panels.title: Failed Requests by Endpoint
panels.description: Error rate per route. Pinpoints which endpoint is failing, not just overall error rate.

options.content: GET /trigger-link-check

panels.title: Total Links Checked
panels.description: Number of product URLs verified in the last link check run. Requires locus_link_monitor_checked_total.

panels.title: Broken Links Found
panels.description: Links that returned 404 or failed in the last check run. Requires locus_link_monitor_broken_total.

panels.title: Broken Links Trend
panels.description: Is the number of broken links growing over time? Rising trend = stores removing products.

panels.title: Impressions per Store
panels.description: How many times products from each store appeared in search results.

panels.title: Result Clicks per Store
panels.description: How many times a result card from each store was clicked to open the detail sheet.

panels.title: Website Clicks per Store
panels.description: Times a user clicked 'View on store →' — intent to buy.

panels.title: Directions Clicks per Store
panels.description: Times a user clicked 'Get directions →' — intent to visit in person.

panels.title: Click-Through Rate per Store (clicks / impressions)
panels.description: What % of impressions led to a result card click. High CTR = store's products are relevant and appealing.

panels.title: Website Conversion Rate per Store
panels.description: Website clicks / impressions. Tells you which stores convert searchers into actual buyers.

panels.title: Most Shown Item per Store
panels.description: Which specific item from each store appeared most in search results.

panels.title: Search Volume by Time of Day
panels.description: When are people searching most? Useful for understanding peak hours and scheduling indexing jobs.

panels.title: Store Engagement Trend
panels.description: Impressions and result clicks per store over time. Rising impressions with flat clicks = relevance issue.

panels.title: Total Items Indexed per Store
panels.description: How many products from each store are currently indexed in locus_items. Sourced directly from Qdrant every 60s.

panels.title: Store Inventory — Items by Store & Category
panels.description: All stores currently in the system with a breakdown of indexed items per category. Refreshed every 60s from Qdrant.

panels.title: Registered Stores
panels.description: Total store accounts registered in the Locus portal.

panels.title: Stores with Products
panels.description: Stores that have at least 1 product indexed in Qdrant.

panels.title: Empty Stores (0 Products)
panels.description: Registered stores that have not uploaded any products yet.

panels.title: Onboarding Rate
panels.description: Percentage of registered stores that have at least 1 product indexed.

panels.title: Missing Info
panels.description: Stores where product data is incomplete — missing name, image URL, or location.

panels.title: Store Directory - All Registered Accounts
panels.description: All store accounts. Refreshed every 30s. Email is first — click any address to open a mailto link.

panels.title: Store Emails — Quick Reference
panels.description: Focused view: store name and email only. Sorted alphabetically. Click email to open mailto.

panels.title: Products per Store
panels.description: Total indexed products per registered store. Red = empty, green = well-stocked (10+).

panels.title: Stores by Mall / Location
panels.description: Distribution of registered stores across mall locations.

panels.title: Onboarding Status
panels.description: Active stores (have products) vs Empty stores (no products uploaded yet).

panels.title: Visual Engine � Request Latency (p50 + p95)
panels.description: HTTP request latency percentiles for the visual_engine service (CLIP + YOLO).

panels.title: Visual Engine � Error Rate (4xx + 5xx per second)
Visual Engine � CLIP Confidence (ML Signal, p50 + p95)
panels.description: p50 and p95 of CLIP category confidence scores. Low p50 signals out-of-distribution or low-quality input images.
